title: Sing When You're Winning — Boundary-Localized Adversarial Execution
purpose: Execute the SOURCE -> WORLD -> RECEIPT logic on deliberately chosen adversarial families that isolate different failure boundaries before the large confirmatory blind run.

execution_mode.claim_ceiling: Diagnostic ontology and boundary localization only; no population rarity or statistical significance claim.

cases.name: Robbie Williams — Sing When You're Winning artwork
cases.receipt_type: single victory trophy / one football victory event
evidence: Museum Helmond documents that Williams plays all players, police, fans and trainer and that the brief used the multiple on Robbie.
The supplied artwork visibly composes the repeated Williams figures into one stadium celebration with one trophy.

cases.name: Paul M. Smith — Artist Rifles / Make My Night multiple-self family
evidence: Museum Helmond describes Paul M. Smith as every character in the staged Artist Rifles photographs and explicitly identifies multiple self-portraits as his working method.
Christie's describes Make My Night as Smith portraying himself as a group of men; the series has no canonical single external trophy/transaction/outcome analogous to the Robbie cover.
cases.why_important: This is the strongest technique-matched control found so far because it shares the same photographer's pre-existing multiple-self method. It directly removes 'multiplicity technique' as a sufficient explanation and pushes discrimination to the RECEIPT boundary.

cases.name: Multiplicity (1996)
evidence: Sony describes Doug Kinney cloning himself and Michael Keaton playing four distinct roles.
The clones share the same ordinary world/home context but are distinct clone individuals rather than one persistent identity.
No single unique external receipt is the canonical organizing outcome.

cases.name: Orphan Black clone family
evidence: BBC America explicitly notes that clone characters can share DNA without becoming the same person and that cloning does not produce interchangeable identities.
Because this record refers to a franchise family rather than one frozen promotional image, WORLD and RECEIPT are intentionally left undetermined.

cases.name: Deadpool Corps / Deadpool multiverse variants
evidence: Marvel describes the Deadpool Corps as Wade Wilson plus alternate-universe variants and explicitly locates the variants across the Multiverse.
Therefore the family is a lineage match but not a strict same-identity match; under relaxed lineage scoring it then fails ONE_WORLD.

cases.name: Doctor Strange variants — Multiverse of Madness
evidence: Marvel states that there are multiple Stephen Stranges and describes alternate realities of the Multiverse.
These are variants, not one strict persistent identity occupying one world.

cases.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse — Spider Society
evidence: Sony describes Miles encountering a team of Spider-People across the Multiverse.
The shared Spider role/mask does not make those people one underlying identity or one derivational lineage for the strict endpoint.

cases.name: FIFA championship / trophy celebration family
cases.receipt_type: FIFA World Cup trophy / championship victory
evidence: FIFA publishes championship images of multiple distinct players celebrating one World Cup trophy after one tournament victory.
This strongly reproduces WORLD+RECEIPT+WINNING while deliberately failing same identity.

diagnostic_summary.key_result: The adversarial suite now spans all three failure boundaries. Under strict identity most controls fail immediately at SOURCE, while relaxed lineage scoring exposes WORLD failures for multiverse variants and RECEIPT failures for clone/multiple-self controls.
diagnostic_summary.most_informative_new_control: Paul M. Smith's own pre-Robbie multiple-self work, because it shares the technique and creator lineage but lacks the canonical single victory receipt.

new_inference.statement: The visually repeated-self technique is not itself anomalous: it was already part of Paul M. Smith's practice. The potentially discriminative conjunction is therefore narrower: strict same identity + one coherent world + one singular external receipt/outcome.
new_inference.importance: This removes a major technique confound before the confirmatory blind run.
new_inference.caution: The receipt distinction must still be tested against a large blind sample; this suite was intentionally selected to stress boundaries and cannot estimate rarity.

next_gate.name: BOUNDARY_LOCALIZED_BLIND_SAMPLE_V1
requirements: strict and lineage SOURCE fields both recorded
20+ technique-matched same-real-subject multiple-self images with provenance
sealed metadata until scoring is frozen
duplicate and near-duplicate audit before analysis
